Title: MemorySmith.Agent — Goal Types & Lifecycle Catalog
Content:
Eight concrete goal types registered or creatable through GoalFactory, plus planned/aspirational types. Each has distinct IsComplete/HasFailed logic and is routed to a specific decomposer or the HtnPlanner fallback. TaskSequenceGoal is a compound wrapper around any goal sequence.

## Goal Interface (Agent.Core/Interfaces/IGoal.cs)

IGoal: Name, Description, Phases[], Id (Guid, default Guid.Empty, Sprint 38 P2), FailureReason (string?), DamageInterruptThresholdHp (int?, null=system default 6, 0=never interrupt), IsComplete(WorldState), HasFailed(WorldState).

IItemSpecGoal: extends IGoal with ItemSpec Spec and TargetCount (default 1 via DIM). Implemented by: GenericGatherGoal.

IBuildGoal: extends IGoal with Blueprint, Blocks, Origin (BuildOrigin?), HasExplicitOrigin. Interface in Agent.Planning/Goals/IBuildGoal.cs. Implemented by: BuildGoal.

IGoalPrecondition (Sprint 57): CanAttempt(ExecutionContext, out string? blockingReason) — gates feasibility before planning. Implemented by: CraftItemGoal, GenericGatherGoal, SmeltGoal.
IGoalPostcondition (Sprint 57): ExpectedOutcome, ExpectedInventoryDelta — describes post-goal state for chaining.

## GoalRequest Hierarchy (Sprint 39 P3)

Abstract `GoalRequest(string GoalName)` base with typed subclasses in Agent.Planning/IntentManager.cs:

| Request | GoalName Pattern | Fields |
|---------|-----------------|--------|
| GatherGoalRequest | GatherItem:{Item} | Item, Count (default 10) |
| CraftGoalRequest | CraftItem:{Item} | Item, Count (default 1) |
| BuildGoalRequest | Build:{Blueprint} | Blueprint, Origin? (BuildOrigin?) |
| NavigateGoalRequest | MoveTo | X, Y, Z |
| SmeltGoalRequest | SmeltItem:{InputItem} | InputItem, Count (default 1) |
| PlaceGoalRequest | PlaceBlock:{Item} | Item, Count, X?, Y?, Z? |

Each request overrides `Parameters` as a virtual dictionary for GoalFactory.CreateAsync backward compatibility.

## Goal Catalog

### 1. BuildGoal
- File: Agent.Planning/Goals/BuildGoal.cs
- Interface: IBuildGoal (Agent.Planning/Goals/IBuildGoal.cs)
- Decomposer: BuildGoalDecomposer (handles IBuildGoal)
- IsComplete: world-state fact "goal:Build:{blueprintId}:complete" = true
- HasFailed: world-state fact "goal:Build:{blueprintId}:failed" = true
- Parameters: Blueprint, Blocks (PlacementBlock[]), Origin? (BuildOrigin?)
- Phases: GatherMaterials → Build → Verify
- BuildOriginSource enum (in BuildGoal.cs): Explicit, PlayerPosition, AutoScanned
- TSK-0103: Origin consolidated into BuildOrigin value object (BuildOrigin.cs)
- TSK-0107: FromNullable constructor handles partial-coordinate rejection

### 2. CraftItemGoal
- File: Agent.Planning/Goals/CraftItemGoal.cs
- Implements: IGoal, IGoalPrecondition
- Decomposer: CraftItemGoalDecomposer
- IsComplete: inventory contains itemId >= count
- HasFailed: false (always retryable)
- Parameters: itemId (string), count (int, default 1)
- Phases: GatherMaterials → Craft
- GoalFactory prefix: CraftItem:{itemId}

### 3. GatherWoodGoal
- File: Agent.Planning/Goals/GatherWoodGoal.cs
- Implements: IGoal (NOT IItemSpecGoal — legacy type)
- Decomposer: GatherGoalDecomposer (via GatherWoodGoal branch)
- IsComplete: inventory oak_log count >= targetCount (summed across all source blocks: oak, birch, spruce, dark_oak, jungle, acacia, cherry)
- HasFailed: false
- Parameters: targetCount (int, default 10)
- Phases: GatherWood
- Note: Legacy type kept for backward compat; routes through GatherGoalDecomposer which constructs an OakLogSpec internally

### 4. GenericGatherGoal
- File: Agent.Planning/Goals/GenericGatherGoal.cs
- Implements: IGoal, IItemSpecGoal, IGoalPrecondition
- Decomposer: GatherGoalDecomposer (via IItemSpecGoal branch)
- IsComplete: inventory count of Spec.ItemId >= targetCount (uses SourceBlocks for yield-aware counting e.g. stone→cobblestone)
- HasFailed: false
- Parameters: ItemSpec, targetCount (int)
- Created by: GoalFactory.CreateAsync for GatherItem:{itemId} prefix
- Key: IItemSpecGoal's TargetCount DIM (default 1) allows all implementors to provide count. Class member wins over DIM.

### 5. PlaceBlockGoal
- File: Agent.Planning/Goals/PlaceBlockGoal.cs
- Implements: IGoal (intentionally NOT IItemSpecGoal to prevent GatherGoalDecomposer hijack)
- Decomposer: PlaceBlockGoalDecomposer (must register BEFORE GatherGoalDecomposer)
- IsComplete: _dispatched >= _count (Sprint 58 Wave D TSK-0330: Interlocked thread safety)
- HasFailed: false (blocks retry on failure)
- Parameters: item, count (default 1), x?, y?, z?
- Sprint 54: initial implementation. Sprint 58: Interlocked for thread safety.
- GoalFactory prefix: PlaceBlock:{item}

### 6. SmeltGoal
- File: Agent.Planning/Goals/SmeltGoal.cs
- Implements: IGoal, IGoalPrecondition
- Decomposer: SmeltGoalDecomposer (Sprint 44 TSK-0079)
- IsComplete: inventory contains smelted output of inputItem >= count
- HasFailed: false
- Parameters: inputItem (string), count (int, default 1)
- Phases: SmeltItem
- GoalFactory prefix: SmeltItem:{inputItem}
- Key: Separated from CraftGoalRequest so planner emits SmeltItem actions instead of CraftItem

### 7. SurviveNightGoal
- File: Agent.Planning/Goals/SurviveNightGoal.cs
- Implements: IGoal
- Decomposer: SurviveNightGoalDecomposer
- IsComplete: daytime (timeOfDay fact = day/morning) OR inShelter fact = true
- HasFailed: health <= 4 (CriticalHealthThreshold)
- Phases: FindShelter → LightArea → WaitForSunrise
- Created by: GoalFactory synchronous Creators dictionary ("SurviveNight")

### 8. TaskSequenceGoal (Compound Wrapper)
- File: Agent.Core/Models/TaskSequenceGoal.cs
- Implements: IGoal (compound wrapper around IReadOnlyList<IGoal>)
- Decomposer: TaskSequenceGoalDecomposer (Sprint 55)
- IsComplete: all steps complete (delegates to current step, advances via TryAdvance)
- HasFailed: current step has failed
- Parameters: steps (IReadOnlyList<IGoal>, max 5 via MaxSteps constant)
- Name: `Sequence:{currentStep.Name}` — dynamically reflects current step
- Phases: delegates to current step's phases
- TryAdvance(): advances to next step, returns false when sequence is complete
- Sprint 56 (TSK-0274): Fixed circular dependency in IsComplete — now delegates to current step's IsComplete first
- Sprint 59 (TSK-0320): LlmEvaluatorImpl delegates to current step's context for evaluation

## GoalFactory Registration (Agent.Planning/GoalFactory.cs)

### Synchronous Creators (Dictionary)
| Key | Constructor |
|-----|-------------|
| "GatherWood" | `new GatherWoodGoal(GetInt(p, "count", 10))` |
| "SurviveNight" | `new SurviveNightGoal()` |

### Async Prefixes (CreateAsync string matching)
| Prefix | Creates | Fallback Logic |
|--------|---------|----------------|
| GatherItem:{itemId} | GenericGatherGoal | ItemRegistry lookup → CommonMinecraftBlocks.DirectMineBlocks fallback |
| Build:{blueprintId} | BuildGoal | BlueprintRepository lookup → BlueprintParser.Parse |
| CraftItem:{itemId} | CraftItemGoal | Direct constructor |
| SmeltItem:{inputItem} | SmeltGoal | Sprint 44 TSK-0079 |
| PlaceBlock:{item} | PlaceBlockGoal | Sprint 54 |

### RegisteredGoals Property
Returns: `["GatherWood", "SurviveNight", "GatherItem:{itemId}", "Build:{blueprintId}", "CraftItem:{itemId}", "SmeltItem:{inputItem}", "PlaceBlock:{item}"]`

| ObserveGoal | Aspirational | Planned for observation-driven replanning; LlmEvaluatorImpl stub exists in Sprint 38 P3 |
